description: Header file defining classes and interfaces for a configuration GUI application using Qt framework, including views, lists, items, dialogs, and main window management.

classes.name: ConfigSettings
classes.description: Handles application settings with size read/write capabilities.

classes.name: ConfigList
classes.description: A widget representing a list of configuration items with various modes and columns.

classes.name: ConfigItem
classes.description: Represents individual configuration entries within the list.

classes.name: ConfigLineEdit
classes.description: A specialized line edit for editing configuration items.

classes.name: ConfigView
classes.description: Main widget for displaying configuration data and controls.

classes.name: ConfigInfoView
classes.description: Displays detailed information about selected configuration items.

classes.name: ConfigSearchWindow
classes.description: Dialog for searching within configuration data.

classes.name: ConfigMainWindow
classes.description: Main application window managing configuration views and user interactions.

methods.name: ConfigList::setRootMenu
methods.description: Sets the root menu for the list.

methods.name: ConfigLineEdit::show
methods.description: Displays the line edit for a specific configuration item.

methods.name: ConfigView::updateList
methods.description: Updates the list display for a specific item.

methods.name: ConfigInfoView::setInfo
methods.description: Sets the information display for a menu.

methods.name: ConfigSearchWindow::search
methods.description: Performs a search within configuration data.
